about: Hand-edited component registry for the Research Governor (research/research_governor.py). Every status, evidence level and flag here is a human decision; the governor reads this file and never writes it. Enums and rules: docs/ops/RESEARCH_GOVERNOR_RUNBOOK.md.

components.name: Daily Research Digest
components.purpose: one nightly note summarising cached research artifacts for the operator
components.notes: Drift audit 2026-09-09 rated it SUPPORT (degrading): about 187 lines and 19 sections, and every new sidecar gets appended. It recommended a cap near 40 lines; the governor flags anything above 60. Governance cleanup 2026-09-12 cut the note to about 95 lines and 13 sections: duplicated candidate lists (top-candidates recap, per-candidate latest-scan records), the decommissioned-funnel appendix while none of its warnings is firing, and the long deprioritisation/policy narratives are gone; the four small evidence/policy sections now share one heading. It is still above 60 because the shortlist, emerging-watch, fundamental and program lines are the journal audit reviewer's only input — it parses the note text, not the sidecars — so cutting them would silently disable deterministic gate checks. Reaching 60 needs that reviewer moved onto the JSON sidecars first (human decision), or a cap raised on purpose.

components.name: DeepSeek journal audit reviewer
components.purpose: LLM critique of the daily digest with a rule-based fallback; queues templated repair tasks
components.notes: One LLM call per night on role chat (since 2026-08-25), under the daily LLM call and token caps. It audits the digest text only and is not a system governor (docs/research/LLM_AGENT_OVERLAP_REVIEW_2026_09.md).

components.name: Feedback queue
components.purpose: human-driven bookkeeping for audit repair tasks; never executes a task
components.notes: Append-only queue and state ledger. Useful only if someone triages it; the governor flags it when the last triage is older than the untriaged_days limit.

components.name: Nightly Operator Summary
components.purpose: short nightly recap; its warnings drive the daily data-quality check
components.notes: Daily operating note step 3: read for data-quality warnings only.

components.name: Daily Alpha Radar
components.forward_hypothesis: board labels are tracked by the forward evidence tracker (overall verdict MIXED)
components.purpose: the one board a human opens daily; review 5-10 names
components.notes: Upstream alpha discovery board is a provider step (FMP), nightly and premarket, under the monthly and daily FMP caps. Operator decision 2026-09-11: this is the only daily candidate source.

components.name: Research scanner and watchlist
components.forward_hypothesis: watchlist entries are tracked by the forward evidence tracker and the scanner-recall cohorts
components.purpose: live candidate discovery feeding the board (discovery only)
components.notes: Cache-first provider step, nightly and premarket. Drift audit: add an explicit per-run cap. Production gates unchanged. Operator decision 2026-09-11: discovery input to the Daily Alpha Radar, not an independent candidate list.

components.name: Forward evidence tracker
components.forward_hypothesis: research board labels beat SPY at 10d under the pre-registered verdict ladder
components.purpose: the one robust forward dataset; settles arguments
components.notes: Sample ROBUST, verdict MIXED. 60d horizons barely matured. Keep; it is the measurement everything else leans on. Batch E (2026-09-12): weekend bars are dropped when resolving forward returns (they belong to another instrument and also shift bar-counted horizons), returns too large to be a price move are quarantined from every statistic and listed in price_artifacts, and each bucket now publishes a robust view (median / winsorized headline) and a per-ticker view (807 names behind 6,214 matured rows). History rows are never rewritten.

components.name: Research programs (tactical / swing / long-term)
components.forward_hypothesis: per-program pre-registered gates on the deduplicated episode ledger
components.purpose: judges each program on its own horizon
components.notes: All three programs INSUFFICIENT_MATURE_EVIDENCE. Ledger rows duplicate episodes about 4.6x (drift audit): any n-based claim must use deduplicated episodes. Precision probe re-pointed 2026-09-12: it read duplication_factor (ledger rows per episode, 4.68), which is high by construction because the ledger re-appends a name every night it is on the board, and which this report never counts as evidence — every statistic and gate here reads deduped episodes. The probe now reads episodes_per_unique_ticker (1.88), which measures what is actually at risk: a ticker entering under several labels contributes several 'independent' episodes. Both numbers stay published.

components.name: Alpha root-cause stop/continue gate
components.purpose: pre-registered CONTINUE / NARROW / FREEZE / SUNSET gate for the standing alpha-engine claim
components.notes: Final gate 2026-09-30: SUNSET criteria apply in full. The interim dates 2026-08-17 and 2026-09-07 passed with no recorded decision.

components.name: High-Conviction shortlist (HC)
components.forward_hypothesis: high_conviction_forward: the shortlist beats program candidates at 10d
components.purpose: selective quality/growth/value/momentum layer above the program views
components.notes: The forward verdict is a comparison against the program-candidate baseline. Until 2026-09-12 that baseline was outlier-contaminated (mean +29.44% against a median of -1.7%) by a single broken price row — PI 2026-08-15, a weekend bar from a 24/7 symbol spliced into the equity series, +189,857% at 10d — and the verdict read NO_IMPROVEMENT_OVER_PROGRAM_CANDIDATES because a real +1.7% lost to it. Batch E quarantines such rows and compares both sides on the outlier-guarded headline: the baseline is now -1.67% and the verdict reads SHORTLIST_IMPROVES_OUTCOMES. That is a corrected comparison, NOT evidence of edge: 423 matured episodes are only 87 distinct names in one regime window, so the level stays NOT_ENOUGH_EVIDENCE until the pre-registered maturity is met. Operator decision 2026-09-11: a label on the board, not an independent candidate list.

components.name: Emerging Outlier watch (EO)
components.forward_hypothesis: emerging_outlier_forward: the watch lane beats SPY on its own pre-registered horizons
components.purpose: separate higher-risk lane kept apart from HC
components.notes: Forward verdict NEED_MORE_DATA. Operator decision 2026-09-11: a label on the board, not an independent candidate list.

components.name: Alpha Focus
components.purpose: same-day manual prioritisation of the day's candidates
components.notes: Prioritisation only (promote_to_signal false). It has no forward hypothesis of its own. Operator decision 2026-09-11: context labels and review ordering only, not an independent candidate list.

components.name: M1 source pool
components.forward_hypothesis: M1 as an unordered basket beats the same-date universe at 60d; pool level only, per-name selection contradicted by replay
components.purpose: second, independent pool for weekly manual review
components.notes: Provisional pool-level evidence: about +1 to +2pp per 60d vs the same-date universe. Never ordered, never ranked. Zero provider calls by default; depends on the hard-capped M1 price refresh. Operator decision 2026-09-11: audit record of what was published; the review packet is the operator surface.

components.name: M1 daily review packet
components.forward_hypothesis: the frozen M1 manual-pick cohort: human selection inside M1 adds nothing (pre-registered falsification test)
components.purpose: alphabetical manual-review worksheet built from the M1 pool
components.notes: Named 'daily', but DAILY_OPERATING_NOTE treats it as weekly depth. Zero provider calls; refuses above 100 planned calls. Operator decision 2026-09-11: weekly depth, never a daily list; the 49 manual-review candidates are a weekly exercise.

components.name: M1 strict manual-review filter
components.purpose: cuts the M1 review load 75 to 49 at zero call cost (liquidity, trend, drawdown, extension, data-quality exclusions)
components.notes: A workload filter, not evidence: no forward test shows the excluded names do worse.

components.name: M1 frozen manual-pick cohort tracker
components.forward_hypothesis: human selection inside M1 adds nothing: the 10 picks will not beat the 65 not picked (decisive 45d and 60d)
components.purpose: pre-registered falsification test of human selection
components.notes: Write-once, git-tracked cohort; weekly user timer, cohort tickers only. Do not re-run, re-date or re-read before 45d (2026-11-06). 60d read 2026-11-27.

components.name: Style-cell leader forward shadow
components.forward_hypothesis: unordered equal-weight style-cell leader basket; pre-declared floor of 30 matured 60d sessions and 4 non-overlapping windows
components.purpose: records unseen forward data for a replay candidate specified after the holdout was read
components.notes: First 60d session matures about 2026-12-04 (business-day estimate from 2026-09-10); the floor needs 30 matured sessions, so no verdict before 2027. Never pooled with the live forward ledger, programs, M1, HC/EO/Alpha Focus or dashboards.

components.name: Social Attention Radar
components.forward_hypothesis: social_attention_forward cohort matrix (social-led vs news-led, early vs viral)
components.purpose: context on why a name already on the list is getting attention
components.notes: The one current social lane (user cron, 21:30 UTC Mon-Fri; StockTwits and Google Trends, capped watch universe). Never a source of names.

components.name: Social Arb / News Catalyst Radar
components.purpose: explains why a name already on the list is moving (news catalysts)
components.notes: A news-catalyst radar, not a social lane. News API, FMP and one LLM noise review per run, under the FMP and LLM daily caps. No registered forward hypothesis; never a source of names.

components.name: Topic Shock Detector
components.purpose: shadow-mode topic discovery; accumulates phrase history
components.notes: Drift audit: nothing downstream reads it. Runs nightly in shadow mode, cache-only. Operator decision 2026-09-11: context only. Reviewed with the governor on 2026-10-23: wire a consumer and a forward hypothesis, or retire it.

components.name: Alpha Heat Radar
components.purpose: helper library imported by the Topic Shock Detector (topic rules, alpha-fit, noise flags)
components.notes: No runner command, artifact or timer. It is a library, not a radar, and should not be listed as one.

components.name: Live scanner-recall cohorts
components.forward_hypothesis: a looser scanner surfaces more eventual winners than the strict scanner and random
components.purpose: prospective recall measurement of the live board
components.notes: LOOSE_NOT_BETTER: coverage met, recall / excess / beats-random gates fail. Recall is not comparable across cohorts (it scales with list size). Keep measuring; production gates unchanged.

components.name: RS/theme lens triage
components.forward_hypothesis: LENS_READY routing beats random and blocked names forward
components.purpose: routes RS/theme early leaders past score gates for lens review
components.notes: Phase 1G.11 recorded a matured NO_VALUE verdict on 2026-06-03 (LENS_READY +0.77% vs random +1.21%, 5d, n=20). The forward sidecar has not been regenerated since 2026-06-07 and reads PROMISING_BUT_UNPROVEN, so the two records conflict. Triage still runs nightly. Daily triage retired 2026-09-11 by operator decision; runnable on demand via the rs-theme-triage subcommand.

components.name: Recall-repair shadow lane
components.forward_hypothesis: sector RS + 20/60 momentum + theme lane recalls more eventual winners than the funnel (forward gate ladder)
components.purpose: research-only recall lane accumulating forward outcomes
components.notes: Drift audit suggested moving it to a weekly cadence.

components.name: Historical replay harness
components.purpose: strategy lab, LRR, core-satellite and failure-miner replays; verdicts recorded and preserved for audit
components.notes: About 30 sidecars frozen since mid-June; their value is that they say no and are dated. Core-Satellite is the one provisional exception and has its own forward shadow ledger. Never consult for candidate selection. Provider risk is HIGH: the manual fetch scripts here default to 8,500-11,500 calls per run (historical_replay_price_backfill, historical_replay_fundamental_fetch) and the M1 analyst-actions study to 3,800, guarded only by the global daily FMP cap, with no planned-call gate. Gated 2026-09-11: research/backtests/common.py require_execute_fetch now applies the planned-call confirmation threshold, so any stage planning more than 100 calls refuses unless --allow-large-run is named, even with --execute-fetch.

components.name: Scanner Truth Review (decommissioned council-funnel autopsy)
components.purpose: autopsy of the council funnel decommissioned 2026-06-13
components.notes: Publishes winner_recall_pct near 0% by construction; it cannot move. core/quarantined_surfaces.py classifies it DECOMMISSIONED_AUTOPSY. Files preserved as history. Removed from the nightly cycle 2026-09-11 (governor cleanup); runnable on demand.

components.name: 10x candidate radar
components.purpose: speculative asymmetric-recovery list
components.notes: No registered forward hypothesis and no validating consumer. Off the nightly schedule since 2026-09-09; runnable on demand. core/quarantined_surfaces.py classifies it QUARANTINE_NO_HYPOTHESIS. Retired 2026-09-11 by operator decision: no forward hypothesis was ever registered. Files and artifacts preserved; runnable on demand.

components.name: Social Attention V11 (superseded)
components.purpose: successor social radar that was never wired to a cadence
components.notes: Superseded by the nightly Social Attention Radar; about two weeks stale with no cadence. core/quarantined_surfaces.py classifies it SUPERSEDED_STALE. Retired 2026-09-11 by operator decision: superseded by the nightly Social Attention Radar. Files and artifacts preserved.

components.name: Options chain snapshot collector
components.purpose: point-in-time Tradier chain history toward IV-rank work (data collection only)
components.notes: User timer 15:45 ET Mon-Fri, about 90 Tradier calls a day, per-run budget guard. IV-rank history reaches the 60-day partial floor around late September 2026.

components.name: API budget / provider gatekeeper
components.purpose: refuses FMP spend above monthly and daily caps before the request; caps LLM calls and tokens per day
components.notes: Enforced since 2026-09-09 (36da6b7). FMP_MONTHLY_BUDGET=0 falls back to the documented default; unlimited needs ALLOW_UNLIMITED_PROVIDER_CALLS=true.

components.name: Dashboards / command center
components.purpose: cache-only read surfaces for the operator
components.notes: Cache-only. The TUI analyzer panel makes operator-triggered LLM calls under its own daily cap. No dashboard work until reports stabilise (operator guidance).

components.name: Cron / systemd timers
components.purpose: runs the premarket, midday, nightly and weekly research cycles
components.notes: Nightly and premarket provider steps spend FMP automatically, under the enforced caps. Premarket repeats the 1,100-call universe price refresh (drift audit recommendation 5). Timers are never changed by the governor.

components.name: Research Governor v0
components.purpose: deterministic, audit-only review of every registered component
components.notes: If it has not helped drive a human decision by 2026-10-23, review it for retirement.

build_proposals.name: New radar, lens, overlay, detector or shortlist
build_proposals.reason: Several surfaces already answer 'which names should I look at' (drift audit 2026-09-09).

build_proposals.name: Per-name M1 ranker or conviction layer
build_proposals.reason: Five independent attempts failed; the ticker-clustered CI is negative at every horizon.

build_proposals.name: New nightly step
build_proposals.reason: The nightly cycle is about 49 steps and should shrink.

build_proposals.name: New dashboard panel
build_proposals.reason: Operator guidance: CLI and JSON sidecars first; wire a dashboard only after a report stabilises.

build_proposals.name: Route or select on a PROMISING_* verdict
build_proposals.reason: No PROMISING_* token becomes a routing or selection rule before its own pre-registered maturity floor.

build_proposals.name: LLM alpha research agent (recursive self-improvement loop)
build_proposals.reason: docs/ROADMAP_PHASES.md: not before the 45d and 60d forward windows mature (M1 cohort reads 2026-11-06 and 2026-11-27) and the production-change checklist is met.

scheduler.cron_note: The user crontab (scripts/social_attention_nightly.sh, 21:30 UTC Mon-Fri) is not read, because that needs `crontab -l`; it is declared under social_attention_radar.
